**Issue #2808 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #2808: CI: a patches promotion or log is stuck
Opened by @github-actions[bot].

<!-- stuck #2775 -->
The technical log's pull request https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/pull/2775 (`patches log`, R1369000) has been open over 2 hours and did not merge itself:

- a conflict with main

Until its entries are on main, the 1 commit(s) it logs are missing from the technical log, and nothing logs them again: a later log holds only what went live after it.

Fix it on a branch from main: add the entries this pull request adds to `crates/cards/patches/technical.json` as they are, each after the entry it follows here, and keep main's, each commit once (`cargo jackioh patches check` holds the file's shape). Keep their `version`, the patch that was live when they went live (R1369000): `cargo jackioh patches log` run again would log them on today's. Fix too any check red here that is red on main. Close this issue with that pull request; the watch in `.github/workflows/patches-ship.yml` then closes this one.

If they are red for a reason outside the repository (CI or Render out of minutes, a spending limit, billing, an account, a runner that never started), no change here fixes it: open the plan with a `**Human required:**` line saying what a person must do, and build nothing.

<!-- jackioh-bot:plan -->
## Plan

_Written by `claude-4` (claude, `opus`, strong) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/41396186601)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._

**Goal.** Put the one entry that the stuck technical-log pull request #2775 adds into `crates/cards/patches/technical.json`, on a branch from main. #2775 is `patches log: 3bee38b..414e158`, branch `patches/log-414e158`, commit `ea7e9233a`.
- Add the entry exactly as that pull request has it, with its `version` left at `v0.5.10`.
- Place it right after the entry it follows there (`"pr": 2698`).
- Keep every entry main already has, so each commit is logged once.
- Main has no red check to fix as well (see **Open questions**).

The pull request closes #2808. Once it merges, the watch in `.github/workflows/patches-ship.yml` finds commit `414e1586c…` on main's technical log and closes #2775.

**Files to touch.**

| Path | new/change | What changes |
|---|---|---|
| `crates/cards/patches/technical.json` | change | Insert one 7-line entry between the `ff76fd6f…` (`"pr": 2698`) entry and the `418aa094…` (`"pr": 2710`) entry |

Do not touch any other file. In particular, leave these alone:
- `crates/cards/patches/patches.json`
- `crates/cards/patches/pending/`
- `crates/cards/catalog.json`
- every Rust or TypeScript source file
- `spec/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `bot/`

Do not run `cargo jackioh patches log`: it would stamp today's newest X, and the issue forbids logging again. Do not run `cargo jackioh spec index`.

Governing ruling: R1369000 (`spec/rulings/R1369000.md`), which defines the technical log. `check_technical` in `crates/tools/src/technical.rs` checks its shape. This change adds no ruling and no spec text.

**Steps.**

1. Open `crates/cards/patches/technical.json` and find the entry whose `"commit"` is `ff76fd6f4895aed536e4dc210970796ada5b0328`. On base `ffafa76b1` it is lines 3901–3907: `"pr": 2698`, title `patches ship: v0.5.10b, v0.5.10c`. The entry after it starts with `"commit": "418aa09434478df4d80a5b47d5fbe83e58efa35b"` (`"pr": 2710`).
2. Directly after that entry's closing `},` (line 3907), and before the `{` that opens the `418aa094…` entry, insert exactly these lines. Indent them with two spaces like the entries around them:

```json
  {
    "version": "v0.5.10",
    "commit": "414e1586c890a310ab2dfda43413963017f44c46",
    "pr": 2765,
    "title": "patches ship: v0.5.10f",
    "kind": "app"
  },
```

   Change nothing else: no reordering, no reformatting, and keep the file's trailing newline. Then run `git diff --stat`: it must show `1 file changed, 7 insertions(+)` and no deletions.
3. Check that the commit appears once: `grep -c 414e1586c890a310ab2dfda43413963017f44c46 crates/cards/patches/technical.json` prints `1`.

Why this position:
- **The issue asks for it.** It says "each after the entry it follows here", and in #2775 this entry follows the `2698` entry.
- **The earlier fix did the same.** #2746 (`f0493b9e3`) inserted the stuck log's entries after the entry they followed in the stuck PR, ahead of main's later entries.
- **The next log PR stays mergeable.** `patches/log-c1f09b9` (`0a20c775d`, `414e158..c1f09b9`) appends after the file's last entry (`348e9a04…`), about 170 lines below this insert, so the two changes do not overlap.

This entry has no `player` line, so it changes neither the Patch notes page nor the GitHub release bodies: `technicalLines` in `apps/web/src/patches/releases.ts` skips such entries.

**Tests.** This is a data fix, and no new test could usefully assert one log entry. These existing checks cover it:
- **`cargo jackioh patches check`:** `check_technical` fails on a commit logged twice, on a version that `patches.json` does not hold (`v0.5.10` is there), on a `cards` kind, on pull request 0, or on a bad player line.
- **`cargo test -p jackioh-tools r1369000`:** this includes `r1369000_the_real_history_logs_onto_meditative_plus` (`crates/tools/src/technical.rs`), which parses the real `technical.json`. It fails on broken JSON or an unknown `kind`.
- **`cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims`:** files under `crates/cards/patches/` are `Area::App`, so the change classifies as App and needs no pending fragment. #2746 passed this way.
- **`pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/patches/github.test.ts src/wording.test.ts`:** both files read the real `technical.json`.

**Done when.**
- [ ] `technical.json` holds the `414e1586c…` entry, word for word as in step 2, directly after the `ff76fd6f…` entry.
- [ ] Every entry main had is still there unchanged, and each commit appears once.
- [ ] `git diff --stat` shows one file, 7 insertions and 0 deletions.
- [ ] `cargo jackioh patches check`, `cargo test -p jackioh-tools r1369000`, `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` and the two vitest files above pass.
- [ ] The harness's checks pass: rustfmt, catalog, patches, rulings, clippy, cargo tests (with no diff in `apps/web/src/wire`), and web tests.
- [ ] The pull request body says `Closes #2808`.

**Risks.**
- **Wrong `version`.** Leave it at `v0.5.10`, as #2775 has it, even if a newer X has shipped since. R1369000 logs a commit on the patch that was live when it went live.
- **A duplicate or a reformat.** Edit the 7 lines by hand. Never regenerate the file with `patches log` or a JSON pretty-printer.
- **Clashing with the later log PR `patches/log-c1f09b9`.** Inserting mid-file, not at the end, keeps the two changes apart. If that PR merges first, the anchor in step 1 does not move: insert at the same place.
- **Game code.** No game crate, replay, determinism or hidden information is involved. Only the tools, the Patch notes page, the static pages and the release script read `technical.json`.

**Open questions.**
- I identified #2775 by its branch, `origin/patches/log-414e158`, because I have no GitHub access to read the PR itself. It is the only log branch that fits the issue:
  - it logs 1 commit;
  - it is based on `f352fd991`, from before #2768 merged;
  - `git merge-tree --write-tree main origin/patches/log-414e158` reports a conflict in `technical.json` and nowhere else.

  If a person finds that #2775 adds different entries, use those instead.
- The issue's only reason is the conflict with main, and it lists no red check. On base `ffafa76b1`, `cargo jackioh patches check` passes (I ran it: exit 0), so nothing else red needs fixing. If CI shows a red check on the pull request, look for the same check failing on `main` before fixing it here (CLAUDE.md rule 12).
<!-- /jackioh-bot:plan -->
````

**Tests.** This is a data fix, and no new test could usefully assert one log entry. These existing checks cover it:
- **`cargo jackioh patches check`:** `check_technical` fails on a commit logged twice, on a version that `patches.json` does not hold (`v0.5.10` is there), on a `cards` kind, on pull request 0, or on a bad player line.

- **`pnpm --dir apps/web exec vitest run src/patches/github.test.ts src/wording.test.ts`:** both files read the real `technical.json`.
